title: MyNFT App
tagline: MyNFT App allows a user send ERC20 tokens and query all NFT of the connected account @OpenSea
description: MyNFT App allows a user send ERC20 tokens, query the network and specifically for this EthGlobal Hack view the NFTs @OpenSea and also using sponsors API as (Covalent, NFTPort and OpenSea) query all NFT of the connected account(ERC721,ERC1155) This App also uses a unique font and images made by JTG (Uruguayan artist last century)
how_its_made:
This dapp extends existing features of open source useDapp (Framework for rapid DApp development https://example.usedapp.io/) 

    - QR code of an address

    - NFT components 

    - API as JSON (Covalent,NFTPort and Opensea)

    - Polygon Bridge 

    - Redesign of colors/fonts/images
